sections.title: Hindustani Vocal: Voice, Raga and the World of Indian Classical Music
sections.description: This course offers students an intimate encounter with Hindustani classical music, a sophisticated musical tradition from North India. Through guided practice, listening, and performance, students enter the world of raga and tala, gaining an understanding of the music through the act of making it. No prior musical experience required; some exposure to Indian music may be beneficial. The course culminates in a public end-of-semester performance.
